params.val: all of the holder's moves become Normal-type and deal ×1.2 damage

the move is already Normal-type with nothing to convert, or is one of a fixed exclusion list that keeps its own type (Hidden Power, Judgment, Multi-Attack, Natural Gift, Revelation Dance, Struggle, Techno Blast, Terrain Pulse, Weather Ball), or is Tera Blast while the holder is Terastallized

verified via Showdown source: previous data was missing the power multiplier entirely. The type-change and the ×1.2 boost are gated together (chainModify([4915,4096]) = 1.2×, the same constant used by Aerilate/Pixilate/Refrigerate/Galvanize, not a unique Normalize-only value) and only apply to moves not on the noModifyType exclusion list.
